title: feat(pm): the relay deletes a closed mailbox's claude/mailbox-* head, and mailbox-open --close sends it in the close stroke
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-elon-musk"} -->
_Requested by **Elon** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01WedDzV26nniwxv7jC88B9D?thread=cmsg_01WedDzV26nniwxv7jC88B9DWNMNPNycXM3h5dzFmhVC6n)_
Fixes #30350
Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- **改了什么**:中继(`objectstack-fleet[bot]`)多了一个只删不建的操作 `mailbox_branch_delete`,只删「已关闭、带 `pm:mailbox` 的 PR 自己的 `claude/mailbox-*` head 分支」;`mailbox-open --close` 关信箱时在同一笔里顺带删掉它。
- **为什么改**:落实 #30350 的裁决 A(「按推荐裁」):云端席位开信箱必须自己推一个分支,关信箱后这个分支删不掉,每坐一次云席就在仓库里留一个永不清理的 `claude/` 分支,预检还会把它读成认领。
- **风险与回滚**:中继 token 本来每笔都带 `contents: write`(给 auto-merge 用),所以 workflow 和权限都没改;路径拒绝表只对 `refs/heads/claude/mailbox-*` 这一种路径开口,建引用、改引用、写文件仍一律拒;删前在 runner 上现读 PR 和分支,未关闭、无标签、head 不符、fork、还有开着的 PR 用同一分支、或分支已不在 PR 关闭时的 head 提交上,任一条就不发 DELETE;`--close` 那一笔里删除被拒时,失败行打印可单独重发的那一条动作。回滚即 revert;中继只跑 main 上的代码,合并前不生效。
- **先看**:① `scripts/pm/fleet-write/ops.mjs` 的新行 `mailbox_branch_delete` 与 `REFUSED_PATH_FAMILIES` 里 `/git/` 那一条(唯一放行的路径形状);② `execute.mjs` 的 `mailboxBranchFenceFailures` / `mailboxBranchPreflight` / `confirmMailboxBranch`;③ `mailbox-open.mjs` 的 `planClose` 与 `closeRemedy`。
- **两分钟验证**:`node scripts/pm/fleet-write/validate.mjs --self-test && node scripts/pm/fleet-write/execute.mjs --self-test && node scripts/pm/mailbox-open.mjs --self-test`,预期三条全绿(337 / 276 / 87 例),其中 ⭐「after close, no branch」那一条钉住关信箱后无分支。
- **需要你做的**:无,席位落地。

## What changes

The relay gains its one ref op, delete-only, by ruling 6674408912 (letter A). Nothing else in the op table moves.

- `scripts/pm/fleet-write/ops.mjs`
  - New row `mailbox_branch_delete`: keys `pull` + `branch`, nothing else. ONE `DELETE /repos/{repo}/git/refs/heads/{branch}`, no body. Permission `contents`, no `alsoSpends`, not `alone`, so it can ride the close stroke.
  - `MAILBOX_BRANCH_SHAPE` (`claude/mailbox-` and a lower-case slug, no slash) and `MAILBOX_LABEL` (`pm:mailbox`, now spelled once; `mailbox-open.mjs` re-exports it).
  - New field `branch`: a `str` held to that shape before the dispatch. A refusal names the shape and never echoes the value.
  - `REFUSED_PATH_FAMILIES`: the `/git/` entry becomes "every `/git/` path but ONE `refs/heads/` ref of `MAILBOX_BRANCH_SHAPE`", built from the shape's own source. `/contents/`, `/branches/` and every other family are byte-identical.
  - Header: a new section "The one row that deletes a ref", the ONE place the fences and the landing are listed (`execute.mjs` and `mailbox-open.mjs` point at it), and the three sentences that said no row reaches a ref now name this one DELETE.
- `scripts/pm/fleet-write/validate.mjs`: `validateField` honours `shape` on a `str` (no echo). Self-test pins below.
- `scripts/pm/fleet-write/execute.mjs`
  - `mailboxBranchPreflight` reads the pull's own `GET /pulls/{n}`, `GET /pulls?state=open&head={owner}:{branch}` and the ref `GET /git/ref/heads/{branch}`, the last three reads before the DELETE. `mailboxBranchFenceFailures` (pure) refuses, the DELETE not sent, unless: the pull is closed; it carries `pm:mailbox`; its head ref is `branch`; its head repository is this repository; no OPEN pull has that head; and the ref's `object.sha` is the pull's `head.sha` (a commit pushed after the close is not the mailbox's). A ref already absent (404) fences nothing; an unreadable ref is refused.
  - `confirmMailboxBranch`: the 204 is not the landing. The ref is read back (`GET /git/ref/heads/{branch}`) and lands only when absent; a ref already gone (the DELETE's 422) is an idempotent landing; a ref still there is a FAILED action.
  - Wiring: the preflight shares the re-run's `pre` slot and its not-sent block; the confirm joins the landed chain. No other row's path changes.
- `scripts/pm/mailbox-open.mjs`
  - `planClose({ repo, pull, head })`: when the head read is `claude/mailbox-*`, `mailbox_branch_delete` of it is appended to the close stroke, last, after `issue_patch state: closed`. Any other head (a thread's own `claude/project-thread-*`, a local seat's `mailbox/LOGIN/SLUG`) is left and the success line says so.
  - `closeLive` re-plans with the head it already reads; the dry run, which reads nothing, prints the same two actions as before plus a line saying the delete rides when the head is `claude/mailbox-*`.
  - `closeRemedy(plan)` (pure): when a close stroke that carried the delete fails, `closeLive` prints it — the pull is closed by then, so `--close` refuses a re-run, and the line gives the one bare `mailbox_branch_delete` action to send through `fleet-write/dispatch.mjs`.
  - The cloud refusal of the open path now prescribes `--head claude/mailbox-SLUG`, the one name `--close` deletes.

## Why

Every cloud seat that opens a mailbox has to push its own `--head` branch, and `--close` closed the pull and deleted nothing, so each cloud seating left a branch that the seat cannot remove (the card body measured four cut-off `git push --delete` attempts) and that pre-flight branch checks read as a claim.

**The first stroke's measurement (the ruling's confidence gap).** The App token does not need any new grant, and the carve-out is one path shape:

- GitHub's server-to-server permission ledger (`github/docs`, `src/github-apps/data/fpt-2022-11-28/server-to-server-permissions.json`, read 2026-11-06): `delete /repos/{owner}/{repo}/git/refs/{ref}` is `contents: write`, `additional-permissions: false`. The create (`post …/git/refs`) and the move (`patch …/git/refs/{ref}`) are the rows that also need `workflows`; neither is spelled by any row.
- `.github/workflows/fleet-write.yml` already mints `permission-contents: write` as a literal grant on every stroke (for the two auto-merge mutations), so the workflow is unchanged and `PERMISSIONS` is unchanged.
- The barrier was the table, not the token: `REFUSED_PATH_FAMILIES` is what keeps a row off `/git/**`. It now lets exactly one shape through, and the self-test pins that this row's DELETE is the only request any row sends under `/git/`.
- The two leftover targets carry no ruleset and no branch protection (`GET /rules/branches/…` answers `[]`, `GET /branches/…` answers `protected: false`, both read 2026-11-06).

## Tests

- `validate.mjs --self-test`: 337 cases, 17 batteries (floor 16 → 17, one battery for the row). The new battery: the shape and the label; a dotted seat slug accepted; twelve names outside the shape refused with the exact sentence and no echo (another thread's branch, a local seat's `mailbox/` branch, an empty slug, upper case, a slash, a dot pair, a trailing slash or dot, a space, `main`, a qualified ref, a path escape); closed keys; the one bodiless DELETE; the close stroke accepted with the five literal grants and nothing stroke-scoped. In "refused by construction" (22 → 24): the ONE request under `/git/` is this row's DELETE, and a positive control that a ref create, another ref, a nested ref, a tag, a tree, a blob, a commit, the singular `ref` read path and `/contents/` are all still caught while the one mailbox ref is caught by none. The two `contents` pins now name the third spender.
- `execute.mjs --self-test`: 276 cases, 23 batteries (floor 22 → 23). The new battery: the good case's call order (pull, open pulls, the ref at the pull's head, DELETE under the App token, ref read-back) and row; the open-pulls query filtered to `objectstack-ai:claude/mailbox-ui-3`; each of nine fences refusing with the DELETE not sent and naming itself (an open pull, no `pm:mailbox`, another head, a forked head, an open pull on the head, a ref moved off the pull's head, an unread ref, an unread pull, an unread open-pulls list); a 204 whose ref still reads back is FAILED; a ref absent before and after, the DELETE answering 422, is idempotent; ⭐ **after close, no branch** — `mailbox-open`'s own `planClose` stroke run through the executor sends the comment, the close, then the DELETE, reads the pull only after closing it, and ends on the ref read back absent; and a head outside `claude/mailbox-*` is closed with nothing sent under `/git/`.
- `mailbox-open.mjs --self-test`: 87 cases (the close-plan battery 3 → 7): the delete rides last for a `claude/mailbox-*` head and the validator accepts the stroke; a thread branch, a `mailbox/` branch, two look-alikes and no head read send no delete; a failed close stroke that carried the delete names the bare re-send through `dispatch.mjs`, whose one action the validator accepts, and a stroke with no delete names none.

## Acceptance notes

- **Fences beyond the ruling's three, each a narrowing.** The ruling names closed + `pm:mailbox` + `claude/mailbox-*`. The executor also requires the head to be this pull's head on THIS repository (the card's "a ref that is not that PR's head", and a fork's same-named branch is not ours), refuses when any OPEN pull has that head, because deleting a branch closes every open pull on it (the dispatch's "never one whose mailbox PR is still open"), and refuses unless the ref still points at the closed pull's `head.sha`, so a commit pushed to the name after the close is never deleted (contract review should-fix 1, comment 6675668758).
- **A refused delete inside `--close` (should-fix 3).** If the relay's pull read lags the stroke's own close, the fence refuses and the pull is already closed, which `--close` then refuses; `closeRemedy` prints the one bare action to re-send instead of leaving the branch behind.
- **Post-landing acceptance probe (the seat, after merge — the relay runs `main`'s code, so it cannot be probed before).** Two of the three leftovers qualify, read 2026-11-06: `claude/mailbox-ui-3` is the head of mailbox #30141 and `claude/mailbox-ui-2` of mailbox #30142, both pulls closed and labelled `pm:mailbox`. The third, `mailbox/os-zhuang/triage-1`, is the head of OPEN mailbox #28646 and outside the shape: ⛔ never touched. The actions file is one stroke, both deletions:
  `[{"op":"mailbox_branch_delete","pull":30141,"branch":"claude/mailbox-ui-3"},{"op":"mailbox_branch_delete","pull":30142,"branch":"claude/mailbox-ui-2"}]`
  sent with `node scripts/pm/fleet-write/dispatch.mjs --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack --actions-file FILE --json`, then re-checked with `git ls-remote origin 'refs/heads/claude/mailbox-*'` (expected: empty).
- **Stale prose outside the surface.** `.github/workflows/fleet-write.yml` L134–135 still says the op table "has NO contents op — no file, ref or branch write — so this grant is spent only by those two mutations". That is false once this lands. The file is Tier H and outside this card's surface (⛔ `.github/workflows/**`), so it is not edited here; reported to the seat to card.
- **Line delta (`scripts/pm/**` net-negative ask).** +230 / −44 over four files: code and header prose +141 / −29, self-tests +89 / −15. `ops.mjs` 2367 → 2407, `validate.mjs` 2036 → 2061, `execute.mjs` 2994 → 3089, `mailbox-open.mjs` 689 → 715. Collapsing the fence prose to one place (should-fix 2) paid back the executor's header section.
- **Overlap watch.** `execute.mjs`'s `requestLanded` (near L593, card #30114's site) is untouched; the new functions sit beside the hierarchy link's, and the loop edit is two lines.
- **Lane.** `scripts/pm/**` only, not governed, publishes nothing: `skip-changeset`.
